Risk: UC Mail (Microsoft 365) puts our login emails in junk or blocks them, so students cannot sign in.
Mitigation: T2 sends a real test email to a @mail.uc.edu inbox in week 1. We set SPF and DKIM on the sending domain. We keep a second provider as a backup.
Trigger: A test email lands in junk or bounces.
Where in Table 1: T2, T7, T11; checked at M2

Risk: A member goes on co-op in Spring 2027 and has less time or works off campus.
Mitigation: Each member confirms spring status by M5 (Jan 15). If someone is on co-op, we move their spring tasks to the others and they take review work. All work is in the repository, so it can be done remotely.
Trigger: Any member accepts a Spring 2027 co-op.

Risk: Exams, Thanksgiving, and other courses slow us down.
Mitigation: No tasks during fall exam week or winter break. Every task has 20% buffer. Each major milestone has a protected buffer block.
Trigger: A task is more than 25% behind at the weekly check.
Where in Table 1: Blocked rows and buffer rows in Table 1; T6, T16

Risk: The free hosting tier is missing the btree_gist extension, or the Render instance sleeps and the outbox relay stops. Search and email then miss AC-01.1.
Mitigation: T1 tests both before M2. If the instance sleeps, we pay for the always-on tier (inside the about $7 per month budget, NFR-07).
Trigger: Extension not available, or a gap over 60 s between relay polls in the logs.
Where in Table 1: T1, T10, T16; checked at M2

Risk: The E1 email provider changes its free limit or price.
Mitigation: The provider is responsible for delivery under its terms. C8 keeps the provider behind one interface (I13), so we can switch providers in about a day.
Trigger: Monthly use goes over 70% of the free limit, or the terms change.

Risk: We cannot find a real property manager to test US-03 (approval).
Mitigation: We seed test property-manager accounts that the team controls (D-09, GQ-04). We ask the advisor for a real contact before M7.

Risk: The Fair Housing phrase list misses a phrase or flags too many fair listings.
Mitigation: Advisor reviews phrase list v1 at M4. Flagged listings go to a person for review, never straight out. The user test checks false flags.
Trigger: More than 10% false flags in the user test, or a missed phrase is found.
Where in Table 1: T4, T8, T18; checked at M4

Risk: The C1 screens and the backend APIs stop matching, because screens are built against mock data first.
Mitigation: Shared zod schemas are the contract. Contract tests run in CI. The protected blocks before M6 and M7 are used for joining the parts.
Trigger: A contract test fails in CI.
Where in Table 1: T12, T15; buffer before M6 and M7

Risk: The CS 5002 calendar and spring break dates are not published yet, so spring dates may move.
Mitigation: We re-baseline Table 1 at M5 when the calendar is posted.
The accessibility checklist is part of T3. axe-core runs in CI from T12, not only in T17.
Trigger: axe-core reports any violation on main.
